content:
Horsehead Corporation is a leading chemical manufacturer headquartered at 300 Frankfort Road, Monaca, Pennsylvania. With a rich heritage spanning more than a century, Horsehead has established itself as a trusted provider of specialized chemical products and materials primarily focused on zinc and related compounds. The company’s expertise lies in the production and refinement of zinc metal, zinc oxide, and other zinc-based chemicals that serve as critical components in various industrial applications.

Situated in Monaca, PA, Horsehead Corporation benefits from a strategic location that supports efficient logistics and supply chain operations, enabling it to serve a diverse range of industries including automotive, construction, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture. The company's products are integral to improving the performance, durability, and safety of countless consumer and industrial goods. For example, zinc’s corrosion-resistant properties are essential in galvanizing steel, while zinc oxide plays a vital role in rubber manufacturing, paints, and personal care products.

Horsehead Corporation prides itself on its commitment to innovation, sustainability, and operational excellence. It continually invests in advanced technologies and environmentally responsible practices to reduce its ecological footprint while meeting the evolving needs of its customers. The company also emphasizes employee safety and community engagement, striving to foster a positive impact on the regions where it operates.

Overall, Horsehead Corporation stands as a cornerstone in the chemical industry, known for its high-quality products, reliable supply, and dedication to responsible stewardship. Its presence in Monaca, PA marks a vital node in the global supply chain of zinc chemicals, reinforcing its reputation as a dependable partner for businesses worldwide.
